text: DSH Teambition 是面向 DSH Web 的 Teambition 项目与任务管理插件。它通过侧边栏面板展示项目、任务列表、看板和卡片详情，并提供 teambition 工具供 DSH 查询和操作任务。用户可以创建卡片、移动阶段或工作流状态、查看任务动态，并将卡片关联到 DSH 工作区后启动会话。适合希望在 DSH 中衔接团队任务与 AI 工作区的用户。使用前需配置已登录 Teambition 账号的 Cookie。

DSH Teambition adds a sidebar panel to DSH Web for browsing projects, task lists and cards. Users can create cards, move them between stages or workflow statuses, and bind a card to a DSH workspace to start a session. Setup requires a Cookie header from a logged-in Teambition account.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · dsh-teambition：English | [中文说明](README.zh.md)

**Bring Teambition into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.** Browse projects, task
lists and cards inside DSH, operate them without leaving the GUI, and run any
card in a DSH workspace you pick: the plugin creates a session in that workspace
and submits the card's title, project, link, updated time and note as the opening
prompt.

- Repository: <https://github.com/Yeezone/dsh-teambition>
- Latest release: `v0.1` (`0.1.0`); `main` is at `0.7.1`
- License: Apache-2.0

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Why it exists：1. Click **Teambition** in the sidebar; the panel opens in the main column.
2. Pick a project (and a task list, for projects with several), then read cards
   per kanban column.
3. Click **Run** on a card: the plugin creates a session in the bound workspace,
   submits the card title, project, link, updated time and note as one queued
   prompt, then opens that session.

Where a card runs is configurable: a per-card binding wins, then the project
default, then the panel-wide default workspace.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Where it lives in the GUI：- **Sidebar row**: registered on the official `sidebar.panellist` seat, after
  "Plugins" and "Automations".
- **Main page**: registered on the official `main` seat, with a Tasks / Board
  switcher plus project / task list selectors, refresh and settings.
- **Task list (default unless the default view is the board)**: a table close to
  the Teambition task module —
  task number, title, assignee avatar and name, due date (red when overdue), stage
  and last update. The toolbar searches, groups by task list / stage / assignee,
  filters by open / done / overdue / unassigned state, and sorts by updated,
  created, due or priority. Clicking a row opens the task page: a two-column
  property grid (state, assignee, creator, participants, priority, story points,
  start, due, stage, task list, task type, created / updated, attachments), the
  note, the (read-only) sub-tasks, the activity feed and custom fields, plus the
  same run / complete / rebind actions as the board.
- **Board**: the project views of the Teambition web board (for example "All
  tasks", a workflow-status view, "My tasks", "Created by me") in a rail

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Features：- Task module: a task table (number, title, assignee, due, stage, update time)
  with search / grouping / filtering / sorting and a full task page; the
  chosen view and toolbar settings persist in `localStorage`.
- Task-list filter: when a project has several lists, the toolbar narrows the
  table to one of them; switching project clears it back to every list.
- Default view: the settings view picks task list or board, and the panel plus
  every project switch open on it.
- Saved views and workflow boards: the board rail lists the project views saved
  in Teambition and remembers the selection per project. Workflow views render
  one column per workflow status (the tasks module look), stage views keep the
  stage columns; "executed by me" / "created by me" views filter their cards,
  and every column can quick-add a card.
- Drag and drop: grab a card on the board and drop it on another column to move
  it there. Workflow status columns update the status, stage columns update the
  stage, the hovered column highlights, and busy cards stay non-draggable.
- Two-level switching (project, then task list). Projects with many task lists

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Quick start：1. Sign in to <https://www.teambition.com> in a browser, open DevTools → Network,
   refresh, select any request, and copy its whole **Cookie request header** (not
   the page URL).
2. In DSH: sidebar → **Teambition** → **Settings** → paste the cookie → save →
   **Diagnose**. A usable cookie reports `Cookie accepted`.
3. Back on the board, choose a project (and a task list if the project has
   several; "all task lists" is grouped by list).
4. Choose a default workspace in settings, or bind one per project or per card.
5. Click **Run** on a card; a session opens in that workspace with the card
   context already submitted.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Quick start：> Cookies expire. When they do, the board and the diagnose verdict report
> `HTTP 401 AccessTokenMissing`; copy a fresh cookie and save it again.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Install：`@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition` is a dual-face cordis plugin package: the
node half (`exports "."`) runs in the host process and serves
`POST /teambition/*`; the browser half (`exports "./client"`) is served to the
GUI as `/plugins/@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition/client.js`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Yeezone/dsh-teambition.git
cd dsh-teambition
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Install：The bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the `ui-teambition` row, so the
profile boot mounts both halves. A **full application restart** is required: the
browser half only loads when the composition includes the new row. After that,
client-only changes need a page refresh.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Install：If the profile is app-owned (the packaged desktop app's `desktop` profile), the
CLI refuses to write it: install from the GUI Plugins page, or add the dependency
and the `dsh.profile.bundles` row to the profile's `package.json` manually, then
restart.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Data and privacy：- Host state lives in `$DSH_HOME/teambition/config.json` (mode `0600`): cookie,
  operator id, endpoint base, workspace bindings, the last diagnose pass, and the
  last project list. Writes are atomic (temp file + rename).
- The browser half receives `configured` and a four character `cookieTail` only;
  the cookie never crosses the host / browser boundary and never reaches
  model-visible output.
- Remote reads use Teambition's own web REST API through a candidate list plus a
  `diagnose` probe rather than hardcoded assumptions; response previews are
  redacted before they reach the settings view.
- The plugin writes to Teambition only for explicit actions (create card, change
  stage, change status); running a card only creates a local DSH session.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Known limits：- Teambition's web REST API is an internal, cookie-authenticated API (not the
  official open API) and may change without notice.
- Pushing a workflow status depends on the project exposing that endpoint;
  projects without workflow statuses can only move cards between stages.
- Card listing is capped at 40 pages of 200 tasks per project.
- No background polling or webhook support: data refreshes when you open the
  panel or press refresh.
- Moving a card across projects is not implemented yet (the path is unverified).

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Versioning and branches：- `main` is the development trunk; `v0.1` is the current frozen release line
  (`0.1.x`).
- New work branches as `feat/<slug>`, fixes as `fix/<slug>`. Every change that
  lands on `main` bumps `package.json` `version` and adds a `CHANGELOG.md` entry;
  the pull request template enforces both.
- Release lines only receive cherry-picked fixes, shipped as patch tags. Tags
  (`v<version>`) and GitHub Releases are cut only after `main` CI is green. See
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Package layout：- `src/core/` - shared vocabulary, wire contract (`protocol.ts`), Teambition
  types / endpoints / mapping / redaction.
- `src/host/` - config store, Teambition REST service, HTTP routes, agent tool.
- `src/client/` - locale dictionaries, API client, panel, sidebar registration.
- `shared/` - build preset vendored from the dsh-web monorepo (tsdown client
  bundling plus the platform seed table).
- `tests/` - vitest suites for both halves.

@yeezone/dsh-client-ui-teambition README · Tests：```sh
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build
```
